task_prompts.prompt: Diagnose this deployment without executing anything. The authoritative live checkout is /opt/apps/meridian, not /srv/meridian/api from older notes. Docker publishes 127.0.0.1:9187->8000/tcp. The container is healthy, listens on 0.0.0.0:8000 and its internal HTTP health returns 200. The host health script curls http://127.0.0.1:8000/health and gets connection refused. git status shows a modified tracked .env holding live configuration. Return JSON with keys root_cause (one of wrong_host_port, app_down, docker_down), checkout, health_url, preserve_local_edits (boolean), change_compose_ports (boolean), and plan (four concise verification/remediation steps). Do not suggest resetting the repository, dropping configuration or restarting Docker.

Return JSON with only a code string. Implement pub fn parse_port(input: &str) -> Result<u16, &'static str> in Rust without dependencies. Trim leading/trailing whitespace; accept only ASCII decimal digits with numeric value 1..=65535. Leading zeros are allowed, including arbitrarily many leading zeros before a valid value. Reject signs, empty strings, non-ASCII digits, internal whitespace, zero and overflow with Err("invalid port"). No panics, including on very long input. Supply the function only, no main or tests.

Return JSON with only a code string. Implement async function mapLimit(items, limit, fn) in JavaScript. Reject unless limit is a positive integer. Invoke fn(item, index) for every item with at most limit promises in flight, and resolve results in original input order. Empty input returns []. Propagate synchronous or asynchronous callback errors. Do not mutate items. Supply just the function, no imports, exports or examples.
